fields.Name: Accounting: List Offboarding Holdings
fields.Description: Lists what a departing user holds in Accounting: every company profile whose CFO approver is that user. Only a company's own CFO approver may name a successor, so each item is listed as not reassignable, with a note to set a new approver in Company Setup.
fields.UserPrompt: List the accounting responsibilities a departing user holds.

fields.Name: LeaverUserID
fields.Description: The departing user's MJ User ID. Give this, LeaverEmployeeID, or both.

fields.Name: LeaverEmployeeID
fields.Description: The departing user's MJ Employee ID. Resolved to the users linked to that employee.

fields.Name: Holdings
fields.Description: JSON array of holdings (App, Domain, Kind, KindLabel, EntityName, RecordID, Label, CanReassign, Note). Kind is CFO_APPROVER; CanReassign is always false.
The leaver resolved; Holdings lists what they hold (possibly nothing).
Neither LeaverUserID nor LeaverEmployeeID was given, valid, or matched a user or employee.
